// Create map

const map = L.map('map', {

    crs: L.CRS.Simple,

    minZoom: -2

});


// Image dimensions

const bounds = [

    [0, 0],

    [1536, 1536]

];


// Add image

const image = L.imageOverlay(

    'assets/maps/grontolom-1.png',

    bounds

).addTo(map);


// Fit image to screen

map.fitBounds(bounds);


// TEST MARKER

L.marker([700, 700])

    .addTo(map)

    .bindPopup(`

        <h2>Historic Center</h2>

        <p>Prototype landmark popup.</p>

    `);


// Coordinate debugger

map.on('click', function(e) {

    console.log(e.latlng);

});
